Ops Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: serving-runtime pool rwd-serve-prod reported 3 pod restarts in 5m (OOMKilled). Observed prefill_gpu_mem_ratio > 0.95 and CUDA error logs. See /runbooks/prefill-oom for triage steps. Paging oncall.

Maya Patel: oncall here. I'm pulling logs from the affected node. Which tenant/route is spiking?

Jonah Lee: looks like tenant-beta-omega hitting massive streaming prompts, route=beta-omega-main. Example request shows approx 85k tokens in prefill (streamed via chunked upload). Node: gpunode-21. Log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-15T21:45:12Z] serving.runtime.prefill: ERROR CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.5GiB for KV cache
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "prefill_worker.cpp", line 519, in allocate_kv_cache
  File "cuda_allocator.cu", line 213, in allocate_device
CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
```

Maya Patel: are our soft guards for token count not firing for streamed requests?

Jonah Lee: right — the token guard runs on full-request assemble path; streaming bypassed that check. We need an immediate mitigation.

Maya Patel: mitigation proposals: 1) temporary per-tenant prefill disable, 2) apply a streaming-chunk size limit and early reject >16k tokens total, 3) drain and cordon gpunode-21 so it doesn't accept new pods while we recover. Which can we do fast?

Jonah Lee: I can push a route-level flag to disable prefill for beta-omega-main. Then update the ingress filter to reject large streaming sessions. Doing route patch now.

Maya Patel: runbook commands?

Jonah Lee: running: ```bash
redwoodctl routes set-attr beta-omega-main prefill_enabled=false max_total_tokens=16000 --reason "incident 1954321100 emergency limit"
kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-runtime-rwd-serve-prod -n inference || true
```

infra-bot: Route config updated for beta-omega-main: PREFILL_ENABLED=false, PREFILL_TOKEN_CAP=16000. Rolling restart triggered for deploy/serving-runtime-rwd-serve-prod.

Jonah Lee: cordoning node gpunode-21 now to stop scheduling while we validate. ```bash
kubectl cordon gpunode-21```

SRE Rotation: note — some in-flight requests failed with 502s during the restart. We should notify affected customers.

Maya Patel: observed immediate drop in OOM restarts after disabling prefill for that route. Pod restarts: 3 -> 0 in last 7m. Good. We still have some degraded latency as caches rebuild.

Jonah Lee: I also ran a small job to evict oversized KV caches and free up memory on the node: ```bash
kubectl exec -n inference pod/serving-runtime-abc -- sh -c 'curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/admin/evict_kv_cache?age_threshold=0'```
Result: freed ~22GiB of GPU cache.

Maya Patel: customer impact summary for comms: "We observed GPU memory exhaustion triggered by extremely long streaming prompts from your account, which caused a small number of 5xx errors. We temporarily disabled prefill processing for your traffic and applied limits on streaming prompt size. We recommend reducing individual prompt sizes; our team can assist with batching/splitting strategies." Agree?

Jonah Lee: agree. Add note that no persistent data was lost and retries are safe.

SRE Rotation: action items captured: - add streaming token guard at ingress (owner: Jonah), - ensure token-count enforcement before entering prefill path (owner: Maya), - add alert for prefill_gpu_mem_ratio > 0.9 tied to paging (owner: SRE Rotation).

Maya Patel: creating incident ticket and will hand off to Jonah for postmortem. Severity suggested: SEV2 — customer impacting but mitigated under 1h.

Jonah Lee: taking postmortem. I'll produce timeline, root cause (streaming bypassed token guard + large KV cache growth during prefill), and remediation plan. Posting immediate follow-ups: RD-1010 enforce streaming token cap, RD-1011 ingress early-reject, RD-1012 prefill cache eviction API improvements.

Ops Bot: Pager escalated to oncall @Maya Patel at 1954321101.

Maya Patel: handing off monitoring to night rotation (SRE Rotation) at 1954321160 — system stable, no new OOMs in the last 12m. Will keep node cordoned till follow-ups done.

SRE Rotation: ack — will watch for 1h and coordinate customer note with outreach. Draft customer-facing message prepared and shared in #customer-comms.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation thread — reopening if any regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
